# Governance Processes

**← Back to [EAP Home](../../README.md) • [Governance](../README.md)**

---

> Standardized governance processes for architecture review, standards development, exception management, compliance monitoring, and change management.

---

[governance/processes/README.md#process-overview]

## Process Overview

Governance processes ensure consistent execution of architectural oversight, providing:

- Systematic approaches to architecture review and approval
- Standardized procedures for exception handling and risk management
- Clear workflows for standards development and lifecycle management
- Repeatable methods for compliance monitoring and assessment
- Structured change management for architectural evolution

### 🤖 [AI Governance Gate Input Review](./ai-governance-gate-input-review.md)

Automated AI-powered pre-review process for governance gate input submissions, ensuring quality, completeness, and readiness before formal review scheduling through intelligent assessment of completeness, cohesiveness, and conciseness.
